title: Gemini 2.0 Flash Text Extractor
description: Layout-preserving document extraction powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash. Supports PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP inputs. An API key is required; it can be supplied here or via the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

adapter_name.title: Name
adapter_name.description: Provide a unique name for this adapter instance. Example: gemini-flash-1

api_key.title: Google AI Studio API Key
api_key.description: API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Leave empty to use the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable instead.

model_name.title: Model Name
model_name.description: Gemini model identifier to use for extraction. Defaults to `gemini-2.0-flash`. Other options: `gemini-1.5-flash`, `gemini-1.5-pro`.

custom_prompt.title: Custom System Prompt / Instructions
custom_prompt.description: Optional additional instructions appended to the built-in layout-preserving extraction prompt. Use this to customise output formatting, focus on specific sections, or handle domain-specific content.
